metadata.name: September 25 review regressions
metadata.provenance: Authored after review findings, with source-based labels. A regression suite used during development; not independent annotation, a held-out set, or field accuracy.

cases.description: An ordinary local module shadows the external agents package.

files.app.py:
from agents import Agent
worker = Agent(name="queue worker")

cases.description: An ordinary local package exports a non-AI Agent class.

files.app.py:
from agents import Agent as Worker
worker = Worker(name="queue worker")

cases.description: A qualified call still refers to the repository-local module.
A locally declared Agent is an ordinary class.
A provider completion without model-selected tool dispatch is not an agent.

files.app.py:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
answer = client.chat.completions.create(model="example", messages=[])

cases.description: Repeated provider calls alone do not establish autonomous tool execution.

files.app.py:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
for i in range(3):
    response = client.chat.completions.create(model="example", messages=[])
    print(response)

cases.description: Supplying a tool schema without executing a selected tool is not a tool loop.

files.app.py:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
response = client.chat.completions.create(model="example", messages=[], tools=[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"lookup"}}])
print(response.choices[0].message.tool_calls)

cases.description: Displaying tool-call arguments without dispatch or feedback is not an agent loop.

files.app.py:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
response = client.chat.completions.create(model="example", messages=[], tools=tools)
for call in response.choices[0].message.tool_calls:
    print(call.function.arguments)

cases.description: An external OpenAI Agents SDK constructor remains recognized.

files.app.py:
from agents import Agent
agent = Agent(name="assistant", instructions="Help the user")

cases.description: An alias for an external agent constructor remains recognized.

files.app.py:
from agents import Agent as Assistant
agent = Assistant(name="assistant", instructions="Help the user")

cases.description: A provider response selects a tool call whose arguments drive execution, with the result fed into the next model request.
Truth-testing model arguments and echoing the result does not execute the requested tool.
Decoding model arguments and echoing them does not execute the declared resolve_ticket tool.
